# Expected values: GoogleSQL compliance functions_testlib_timestamp.cc,
# GetFunctionTestsDateTrunc/GetFunctionTestsDateDiff; BigQuery date functions define
# WEEK(weekday) as boundaries on that weekday, including for DATETIME.

SELECT DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(MONDAY)) FROM UNNEST([DATE '2001-12-30']) d
=> "2001-12-24"

SELECT DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(TUESDAY)) FROM UNNEST([DATE '2001-12-30']) d
=> "2001-12-25"

SELECT DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(WEDNESDAY)) FROM UNNEST([DATE '2001-12-30']) d
=> "2001-12-26"

SELECT DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(THURSDAY)) FROM UNNEST([DATE '2001-12-30']) d
=> "2001-12-27"

SELECT DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(FRIDAY)) FROM UNNEST([DATE '2001-12-30']) d
=> "2001-12-28"

SELECT DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(SATURDAY)) FROM UNNEST([DATE '2001-12-30']) d
=> "2001-12-29"

SELECT DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(MONDAY)) FROM UNNEST([DATE '1970-01-01']) d
=> "1969-12-29"

SELECT DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(TUESDAY)) FROM UNNEST([DATE '1970-01-01']) d
=> "1969-12-30"

SELECT DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(WEDNESDAY)) FROM UNNEST([DATE '1970-01-01']) d
=> "1969-12-31"

SELECT DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(THURSDAY)) FROM UNNEST([DATE '1970-01-01']) d
=> "1970-01-01"

SELECT DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(FRIDAY)) FROM UNNEST([DATE '1970-01-01']) d
=> "1969-12-26"

SELECT DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(SATURDAY)) FROM UNNEST([DATE '1970-01-01']) d
=> "1969-12-27"

SELECT DATE_DIFF(d, DATE '2000-01-04', WEEK(MONDAY)) FROM UNNEST([DATE '2000-01-02']) d
=> "-1"

SELECT DATE_DIFF(d, DATE '2000-01-05', WEEK(TUESDAY)) FROM UNNEST([DATE '2000-01-03']) d
=> "-1"

SELECT DATE_DIFF(d, DATE '2000-01-06', WEEK(WEDNESDAY)) FROM UNNEST([DATE '2000-01-04']) d
=> "-1"

SELECT DATE_DIFF(d, DATE '2000-01-07', WEEK(THURSDAY)) FROM UNNEST([DATE '2000-01-05']) d
=> "-1"

SELECT DATE_DIFF(d, DATE '2000-01-08', WEEK(FRIDAY)) FROM UNNEST([DATE '2000-01-06']) d
=> "-1"

SELECT DATE_DIFF(d, DATE '2000-01-09', WEEK(SATURDAY)) FROM UNNEST([DATE '2000-01-07']) d
=> "-1"

SELECT CAST(DATETIME_TRUNC(d, WEEK(THURSDAY)) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([DATETIME '1970-01-01 12:34:56']) d
=> "1970-01-01 00:00:00"

SELECT DATETIME_DIFF(d, DATETIME '2000-01-04 12:34:56', WEEK(MONDAY)) FROM UNNEST([DATETIME '2000-01-02 12:34:56']) d
=> "-1"

SELECT DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(MONDAY)) FROM UNNEST([DATE '0001-01-01']) d
=> "0001-01-01"

SELECT SAFE.DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(TUESDAY)) FROM UNNEST([DATE '0001-01-01']) d
=> null

SELECT DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(TUESDAY)) FROM UNNEST([DATE '0001-01-01']) d
=> error:

SELECT DATE_DIFF(d, DATE '0001-01-01', WEEK(TUESDAY)) FROM UNNEST([DATE '9999-12-31']) d
=> "521723"

SELECT DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(FRIDAY)) FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS DATE)]) d
=> null

SELECT DATE_DIFF(d, DATE '2000-01-01', WEEK(FRIDAY)) FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS DATE)]) d
=> null

SELECT DATE_DIFF(DATE '2000-01-01', d, WEEK(FRIDAY)) FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS DATE)]) d
=> null

SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(THURSDAY)) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([DATETIME '1970-01-01 12:34:56']) d
=> "1970-01-01 00:00:00"

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%F %T', TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(d, WEEK(THURSDAY))) FROM UNNEST([TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01 12:34:56+00']) d
=> "1970-01-01 00:00:00"

SELECT SAFE.DATETIME_TRUNC(d, WEEK(TUESDAY)) FROM UNNEST([DATETIME '0001-01-01 12:34:56']) d
=> null

SELECT DATETIME_TRUNC(d, WEEK(TUESDAY)) FROM UNNEST([DATETIME '0001-01-01 12:34:56']) d
=> error:

SELECT DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(SUNDAY)) FROM UNNEST([DATE '1970-01-01']) d
=> "1969-12-28"

# TIMESTAMP differences accept fixed units through DAY, never calendar weeks.
SELECT TIMESTAMP_DIFF(d, TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01', WEEK(MONDAY)) FROM UNNEST([TIMESTAMP '2000-01-04']) d
=> error:
